title: Certified Access: Test-Time Compute on Conservative Physics-Structured AI Memory
abstract: arXiv:2610.39073v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Test-time compute mechanisms, such as retries, confidence-based escalation and non-local routing, are conventionally deployed as black-box additions to trained models. They typically add forward passes or halting heads, but give no structural account of what the extra compute buys or what it costs against the model's stability guarantees. We therefore propose a theoretical and empirical framework for test-time compute on a Latent Dynamics Model used as the memory. When an encoder's latent state $(q,p)$ is advanced by a damped symplectic (velocity-Verlet) step of a learned Hamiltonian, every mechanism that expands access has an exact phase-volume Jacobian, a bounded energy change and an exact latch-transport law. We split reachability failures into escape failures and reach failures. A Lorentz squeeze resolves escape failures by injecting bounded, re-absorbable energy. translated_title: 认证访问：保守物理结构化人工智能记忆上的测试时计算
translated_abstract: 测试时计算机制，例如重试、基于置信度的升级和非局部路由，通常被部署为已训练模型的黑盒附加组件。它们通常只是增加前向传播次数或添加停止判别头，但对于这些额外计算究竟能带来什么、以及相对于模型稳定性保证而言其代价是什么，却缺乏结构性的解释。因此，我们提出了一个针对潜动力学模型作为记忆的测试时计算的理论与实证框架。当编码器的潜状态 $(q,p)$ 由学习到的哈密顿量的阻尼辛（速度-Verlet）积分步推进时，每一种扩展访问的机制都具有精确的相体积雅可比行列式、有界的能量变化以及精确的锁存-输运定律。我们将可达性失败划分为逃逸失败和到达失败两类。洛伦兹挤压通过注入有界且可重新吸收的能量来解决逃逸失败；门控正则变换（跨越 $C_T$ 的一步通道）解决了……（原文摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 该论文将重试、置信度升级、非局部路由等测试时计算机制构建于保守哈密顿潜动力学记忆模型之上，为每一种扩展访问的机制给出精确的相体积雅可比、有界能量变化和锁存-输运定律，首次以可认证的结构化方式刻画了额外计算所带来的收益与代价。
en_tdlr: The paper grounds test-time compute mechanisms (retries, confidence-based escalation, non-local routing) in a conservative Hamiltonian latent-dynamics memory model, certifying every access-expanding mechanism with an exact phase-volume Jacobian, bounded energy change, and latch-transport law, thereby providing a certified structural account of what extra compute buys and costs.
